records.statement: Elliptic's earlier update characterized the Aave position as near liquidation. LlamaRisk's Aave risk-team forum update says $59.9M USDT collateral against $43.8M debt, overcollateralized and no supplier risk. Preserve both claims; use the protocol-proximate Aave statement for the reported position state, but do not claim an independently audited health factor.

Aave's freeze counts, utilization, rate changes and cap reductions are reported by LlamaRisk, a protocol risk contributor. They have not all been independently reconciled to guardian-multisig and reserve event logs in this run.
The Aave V4 Arc launch roster includes USDC, EURC, cirBTC and WETH, with no XRP. This establishes no XRP reserve at launch, not a permanent prohibition or proof of future non-listing.

CleanSky reports 85.4% of Aave V4 Arc Main Spoke USDC held by three unlabeled addresses at September 24, 2026. The addresses' beneficial owners and relationship to institutions are unknown; do not label them as Coinbase, Circle, SBI or any named fund.

Decrypt quotes Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire as saying more than $800M USDC was frozen in coordination with law enforcement; the article's on-chain tally is approximately 823M. The direct X post was not independently retrieved in this run.

Binance's verified-account update says 80% of exact impacted token assets were already held and the remaining 20% was being acquired. No XRP-specific amount, purchase venue, execution price or replenishment address is disclosed.

No direct Coinbase capital flow into Aave V4 Arc, no XRP collateral on Aave V4 Arc and no Coinbase-specific XRP purchase are established by the current sources. Coinbase's USDC distribution and cbXRP custody are separate relationships.

Aave's reported LTV 0/collateral-factor 0 changes restrict new borrowing power when affected assets are used as collateral; they do not by themselves mean assets were liquidated, markets paused or existing positions automatically lost liquidation thresholds.
